content:
Fixed both occurrences of **"artefact"** → **"artifact"** on lines 4 and 6. 

"Artifact" is the standard spelling in software engineering and technical documentation (referring to build artifacts, deployment artifacts, etc.), whereas "artefact" is the British English variant more commonly used in archaeology or general contexts.
